DELIRIUM
Introduction
A transient disorder of brain function. Manifests as a global cognitive
impairment and behavioural disturbance. More common at the extremes of life,
though it can occur at any age. Incidence up to 15% has been reported among
general medical inpatients; up to 40% among acutely ill geriatric patients. Poor
detection and mis-diagnosis are common
Most common causes:
- Trauma
- Infections
- Metabolic derangements
- Side effects of drugs
